topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I heard tell of a hidden room found in the new house at the edge of our village, and the whisper of it runs through the village like the first shoots pushing through soil. To think there's a place unseen, untouched by the hands of time, and all this while under their very roof! Such a discovery speaks of secrets and stories, like the tales of old that we share on long winter nights. It makes one wonder what else might be hidden, not just in walls, but in the hearts of the earth we till and the air we breathe. The saints know, perhaps there are miracles yet to be unearthed, waiting to surprise us in the most ordinary of places.
